props.text: After-builders cleaning in Manchester you can rely on

Cleaniq Services provides post-construction cleaning in Manchester and across Greater Manchester. After building work, renovation or a refurbishment, our after-builders cleaners remove the fine dust, debris, paint splashes and grime that standard cleaning can't deal with, leaving the property ready to live in, let or hand over.

Construction dust gets everywhere: on every surface, inside cupboards, on light fittings and along skirting boards. We use HEPA-filter industrial vacuums and specialist products to remove it properly instead of spreading it around, then clean every surface, fixture and floor.

Call us on [07846 726428](tel:+447846726428) or use our [quote form](/get-a-quote) to tell us about your project. Moving into a home after the work? props.text: Why a Professional Post-Construction Clean is Essential

Construction dust is not ordinary household dust. Fine plaster, cement, and drywall particles are abrasive — damaging to surfaces, harmful when inhaled, and impossible to remove effectively without industrial-grade equipment. Attempting to clean a post-build property with a domestic vacuum simply redistributes the dust rather than removing it.

A professional builders clean from Cleaniq Services uses HEPA-filter industrial vacuums that capture particles down to 0.3 microns — ensuring that fine construction dust is fully removed rather than recirculated into the air. This protects both the occupants and the surfaces of your newly completed property.

For developers and contractors, a professional post-construction clean is also a contractual and reputational requirement. Properties handed over with visible dust, paint residue, or construction debris create a poor first impression and can result in snagging disputes. A professional handover clean from Cleaniq Services ensures your project is completed to the standard your clients expect.

props.text: Frequently Asked Questions: Post-Construction Cleaning Manchester

items.q: What is included in a post-construction clean?
items.a: Our builders clean includes full dust removal from all surfaces using industrial HEPA vacuums, paint splash removal, protective film and sticker removal from fixtures and glazing, grout haze removal, and a full floor clean — leaving the property ready for occupation or handover.

items.q: How long does a post-construction clean take?
items.a: A typical one-bedroom flat takes 4–6 hours. Larger residential properties or commercial fit-outs are quoted individually following a site assessment. We work to your handover deadline.

items.q: Do you work on commercial construction sites?
items.a: Yes. We handle post-build cleans for residential refurbishments, new-build developments, commercial office fit-outs, retail spaces, and industrial units across Greater Manchester.

items.q: Can you remove paint from floors and surfaces?
items.a: Yes. We use specialist products to remove paint splashes, sealant residue, and adhesive from hard floors, tiles, glass, and fixtures without causing surface damage.

items.q: What Manchester areas do you cover for post-construction cleaning?
items.a: We cover all of Greater Manchester including City Centre, Salford, Didsbury, Stockport, Trafford, Wythenshawe, Ancoats, and surrounding postcodes.

items.q: How much does post-construction cleaning cost in Manchester?
items.a: It depends on the size and condition of the property and what work was done. Larger properties and commercial fit-outs are quoted individually after a site assessment. Call us or use our quote form for a quote.

items.q: When should I book a post-construction clean?
items.a: Once all trades have finished, including painters and decorators, so no new dust is created after the clean. We'll plan the date around your handover.
We remove site debris from the immediate access areas as part of the clean. Large waste such as rubble, skips and old fittings should be cleared by your builder first.

items.q: Can you clean a new-build home before we move in?
items.a: Yes. We clean new-build homes and developments, removing construction dust, stickers and protective film so the property is ready to move into.

items.q: Is a post-construction clean the same as a deep clean?
items.a: No. A post-construction clean is designed for properties after building work, removing fine construction dust, paint splashes and protective film. A deep clean is for lived-in homes that need a top-to-bottom refresh.
